ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against narrow low-intensity (black) pixel regions at the peduncle base and distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white contiguous field across both lobes. Small localized black pigment blobs at the peduncle insertion. Faint, diffuse yellowish-brown chromatic cluster in the center-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated vertex angle of 80 degrees; depth is moderate relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the majority of the trailing edge; significantly higher amplitude irregular peaks and valleys localized at the far right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering into slightly concave trailing edge trajectories that converge at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of dark, circular high-contrast pixel groupings located on the distal end of the right lobe; sparse micro-spots distributed along the black boundary of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, appearing as rake marks against the white background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular scarring and possible tissue loss/encrustation on the outer margin of the right fluke tip, characterized by dense dark pixel clusters.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan staining (diatom film) visible in the mid-fluke area, distinct from the primary white/black pigmentation.
